author: DroneBetter

entries.text: Compute `stirling(n,k)` by performing the recurrence in a parallelogram instead of a trapezoid; this is about twice as fast at generating full rows, and saves about a linear factor for small/fixed `n-k`.

  * Compute `stirling(n,k)` by performing the recurrence in a parallelogram instead of a trapezoid; this is about twice as fast at generating full rows, and saves about a linear factor for small/fixed `n-k`.
title: make Stirling numbers take `Θ(k*(n-k))` ops instead of `Θ(k*(n-k/2))`
